t: The Brackenheath iSpot Frameless round LED bulkhead is an outdoor security light designed to provide clear, bright illumination. Ideal for illuminating building entrances, pathways, and utility areas. This 9W mains-powered unit delivers 1150lm of cool white light. A polycarbonate body and diffuser ensure corrosion-resistant, dustproof, and waterproof protection with an IP65 rating. The integrated PIR and photocell sensor offers a 180° 10m range with 4-in-1 control modes, including manual override and PIR with 80% dimming options, lasting up to 30,000 hours.
b: Frameless Round Design Fits Sleek Modern Spaces
